text: Healthy living is about taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly — even a short walk every day makes a difference. Good sleep is also important, so try to go to bed and wake up at the same time. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and do things you enjoy. Finally, keep a good work-life balance by spending time on hobbies and with family. Small daily habits can lead to a healthier, happier life.
